claims.claim: The paper reports experimentally validated biphonic simulations and systematic effects of tract geometry on resonance modulation and syllable bandwidth.
claims.limitations: The model concerns avian vocalization rather than human speech; micro-CT reconstruction, source assumptions, and validation recordings constrain the result. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports a representation model expanded to 1,226 African languages and evaluates its transfer against multilingual baselines.
claims.limitations: Language coverage does not mean equal data quality or equal downstream performance; the languages, hours, speaker balance, and task results determine the practical reach. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports improvements for open end-to-end spoken dialogue modeling from chain-of-thought training and evaluates the resulting response behavior.
claims.limitations: Reasoning traces are supervision artifacts and do not prove faithful internal reasoning; task distribution, annotation quality, and evaluation subjectivity constrain the claim. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports that AI voice clones struggle with dynamic F0 variation and analyzes its relationship to naturalness and similarity ratings.
claims.limitations: Listener population, prompts, voices, and rating protocol limit generalization; perceptual association does not establish that changing F0 alone fixes naturalness. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports multichannel separation results with a deep-simplex approach designed for variable source conditions and compares it with established separators.
claims.limitations: Performance depends on microphone geometry, room conditions, source count, and the reference metrics; synthetic mixtures may not represent real overlap. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports an alternating multi-module SASV system with score-aware gating and evaluates it on speaker-authentication trials.
claims.limitations: Thresholds and spoof types determine operating behavior; benchmark attacks do not exhaust unseen synthesis or replay conditions. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports comparative embedding similarities involving Australian Aboriginal and high-resource languages and discusses implications for underrepresented-language technology.
claims.limitations: Similarity is not a language description or a guarantee of recognition transfer; data quantity, speaker coverage, and community context limit interpretation. No independent reproduction was performed.

claims.claim: The paper reports a real-time subjective-quality model intended to approximate listening-test judgments more cheaply and quickly.
claims.limitations: Human ratings, test conditions, and audio distortions define the target; a predictor can reproduce annotator bias and fail on unseen codecs or populations. No independent reproduction was performed.
